name: How do I know if I need a damaged shingle assessment?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I need a damaged shingle assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a damaged shingle assessment if you notice visible signs of damage like missing or broken shingles, leaks inside your home, or after a severe weather event such as a hailstorm or strong winds. Even if you don't see obvious issues, a professional assessment can identify hidden damage before it leads to larger problems. It's a proactive step to maintain your roof's health and prevent costly repairs down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule an assessment if you see visible shingle damage, have leaks, or after severe weather; it can catch hidden issues early.
